During my review of the bond terms this week, I determined that the contractual cash flows include a contingent step-up feature. As a result, this position must be recorded at fair value through profit or loss rather than held at amortized cost. My accounting memo detailing this conclusion is awaiting circulation, but I wanted to ensure the committee is aware of this classification requirement before any vote is recorded, as it affects how the position will be carried on the balance sheet and how changes in fair value will flow through earnings.
